label.purpose: State, path, code, and numeric readouts.

brand.purpose: Georgia is used only for the pi symbol in the brand mark.

shadows.name: input-plane
shadows.purpose: Composer separation from the work floor.

motion.name: live-trace
motion.purpose: Instrument trace movement only while the agent runs.

components.name: Primary Icon Button
components.css: .ds-primary-icon { width: 38px; height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #008f8a; border-radius: 5px; background: #008f8a; color: #fff; font: 700 18px Aptos, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary-icon:hover { background: #14201d; } .ds-primary-icon:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,143,138,.24); }

components.name: Segmented Navigation
components.css: .ds-segments { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 5px; border: 1px solid #c4d0cc; background: #fff; } .ds-segment { height: 33px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #465650; font: 650 12px Aptos, sans-serif; } .ds-segment:hover, .ds-segment.active { border-color: #c4d0cc; background: #e5ece9; color: #14201d; } .ds-segment:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,143,138,.24); }

components.name: Composer
components.description: Bounded expanding prompt field on the active work plane.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; align-items: end; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 13px; border: 1px solid #8fa19a; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 7px 22px rgba(18,31,27,.1); } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: #008f8a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,143,138,.24), 0 7px 22px rgba(18,31,27,.1); } .ds-composer textarea { min-height: 34px; flex: 1; resize: none; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #14201d; font: 14px/1.45 Aptos, sans-serif; } .ds-composer button { height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: #008f8a; color: #fff; }

components.name: Tool Result
components.description: Framed boundary for actual agent tool work.
components.css: .ds-tool { border: 1px solid #c4d0cc; border-radius: 5px; background: #f8fbfa; color: #14201d; font: 10px Cascadia Code, monospace; } .ds-tool header { min-height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; } .ds-tool i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #008f8a; } .ds-tool pre { margin: 0; padding: 9px 10px 11px; border-top: 1px solid #c4d0cc; color: #465650; white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Signal Scope
components.description: Run-state instrument field with an active cyan trace.
components.css: .ds-scope { position: relative; padding: 9px; border: 1px solid #8fa19a; border-radius: 3px; background: #15211e; color: #c8e9e5; } .ds-scope svg { width: 100%; height: 70px; } .ds-scope path { fill: none; stroke: #35c7c0; stroke-width: 1.6; } .ds-scope span { display: block; text-align: right; font: 650 9px Cascadia Code, monospace; }

narrative.overview: piY Web treats the coding agent as a local instrument under active observation. The conversation occupies the work floor while sessions, files, models, and run telemetry stay on fixed perimeter rails. State color always carries meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic cyan, amber, and red signals

rules.name: Signal Integrity
rules.body: Cyan, amber, and red are state channels, never decorative accents.

rules.name: Clear Floor
rules.body: The central column belongs to the current task; tools remain on perimeter rails.

rules.name: Flat at Rest
rules.body: Persistent panels use borders or tonal separation, not shadows.

dos: Keep chat content unframed and readable.
Map every signal color to an observable state.
donts: Do not build a field of generic rounded cards.
Do not use monospace for ordinary prose.
Do not add gradients or decorative glow effects.
